mechanisms.atomic_writes: VERIFIED - Temporary file (.tmp) written first, followed by atomic replace (os.replace / Path.replace)
mechanisms.secret_scrubbing: VERIFIED - Regex scrubber removes Groq, xAI, Gemini, and Bearer authorization tokens prior to disk persistence
mechanisms.duplicate_prevention: VERIFIED - FINAL_STATUSES guard blocks repeated approval or rejection on finalized records
mechanisms.reviewer_validation: VERIFIED - Non-empty string constraint enforced on reviewer name
mechanisms.corruption_detection: VERIFIED - _read_store() catches JSONDecodeError and IOErrors gracefully returning empty dictionary
mechanisms.schema_validation: VERIFIED - Pydantic model validation on WorkflowRecord deserialization rejects malformed schemas

security_model_and_tamper_limitations: A local JSON record store with cryptographic hashes stored alongside the records does NOT
prevent an attacker with local file access from altering both the record and the hash simultaneously.
To achieve non-repudiation and true tamper resistance in enterprise production, records must be
signed using private asymmetric keys managed by a Hardware Security Module (HSM) or committed to
an immutable, append-only distributed ledger or cloud write-once-read-many (WORM) audit storage.
